target_statement: For every finite group G, every complex irreducible character chi of G, and every x in G, if chi(x) is nonzero then o(x) divides |G|/chi(1), equivalently o(x)chi(1) divides |G|.

source_clauses.text: Let chi be a complex irreducible character of a finite group G. If chi(x) is nonzero for x in G, must o(x) divide |G|/chi(1)?
The assertion is known to hold when G is solvable.
For arbitrary G it is known that (o(x)chi(1))^4 divides |G|^5.

constraints.statement: The assertion quantifies over every triple (G,chi,x) satisfying all remaining admissibility rows.
chi is an ordinary irreducible complex character of G.
x is an element of G and o(x) denotes its exact element order.
The exact complex character value chi(x) is nonzero.
o(x) divides |G|/chi(1), equivalently the integer o(x)chi(1) divides |G|.

excluded_scopes: Brauer or modular characters in place of ordinary irreducible complex characters
The already-known restriction to solvable groups
A bounded character-table screen presented as a proof of the universal assertion

success_criteria.proof: Prove the divisibility implication for every finite group G, every ordinary irreducible complex character chi, and every x with chi(x) nonzero.
success_criteria.counterexample: Give one reconstructible finite group G, irreducible complex character chi, and element x with chi(x) nonzero but o(x)chi(1) not dividing |G|.
partial_progress: A complete independently reproducible screen of a precisely stated character-table family.
A proved reduction to a named nonsolvable or almost-simple family with exact primewise divisibility conditions.
success_criteria.certificate: A reconstructible group or exact character-table identifier, class representative/order, character row and degree, exact cyclotomic nonzero value, and the failed integer divisibility; or a line-by-line universal proof.

truth_likelihood.rationale: The known solvable case and weaker universal bound favor truth, while one exact nonsolvable character-table row would refute the assertion compactly. This is a scheduling estimate only.
